tools.name: search_goora_posts
tools.description: Find first-hand community sources for destination planning, citywalk and family trips / 攻略、游记、亲子旅行. Start with a short destination such as 上海 or 大理; space-separated keywords must all match. If empty, follow searchHints.suggestedQueries or retry the destination alone rather than repeatedly adding act

tools.name: get_goora_post
tools.description: Read a Goora public travel post by its exact string post_id returned by search. Rechecks public visibility and safety status live; private/withdrawn posts are not returned. Cite url and modifiedAt. contentStatus=image-or-title-only means no text body was supplied, not that image facts are known.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_goora_posts, get_goora_post · Private data: get_goora_post · Public sink: get_goora_post.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_goora_posts, get_goora_post · Private data: get_goora_post · Public sink: get_goora_post

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "search_goora_posts" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
